Wednesday 24 June 2026 at 19:00 UTC. Bosnia and Herzegovina and Qatar on the card. On the Qatar side, the engine's number sits +10.1pp clear of the market — a wide disagreement by the engine's standards this far out from kickoff.

Elo numbers going in: Bosnia and Herzegovina 1660, Qatar 1640. That's a 20-point lead for Bosnia and Herzegovina — closer than a casual reader of the market price might assume. Both Elo numbers are pulled live from the public Elo source. No host, home-ground, or altitude adjustments apply here; the prior reads straight from Elo.

Three-way split from the model: Bosnia and Herzegovina to win at 38%, the draw at 29%, and Qatar to win at 34%. The away side reads 34% on this distribution — the model's central case for Qatar.

On the same three-way, Polymarket: Bosnia and Herzegovina to win at 42%, the draw at 25%, and Qatar to win at 24%. On the Qatar side specifically the market reads 24%, which prices out at American odds of +326. Compared against the model's 34%, that's the +10.1pp gap the Pick rests on.

Pick gate is a lower-bound check, not the point estimate. A 100-sample bootstrap perturbs the Elo prior (±20), the host bonus (±15), and the altitude bonus (±10), then reads the 5th-percentile probability back out. On the Qatar side that lower bound is 29% — +5.2pp clear of the market's 24%, comfortably past our +3pp threshold. The engine isn't arguing reputation, recency, or narrative. It's reading the underlying numbers and finding Qatar priced shorter on the market than the prior supports — that's the disagreement.

This number will move. The confirmed starting eleven, fitness news, weather at the venue, and any tournament suspension carried in from previous matches all feed back into the prior. With kickoff 33 days out, the refresh is weekly until we cross five days, then daily, then hourly inside the final day. A wide Pick can collapse into a Pass if news moves enough of the read. Editorial analysis only — Odds Primer does not place trades and does not recommend a wager.
drivers: This is a selection call on the Qatar side, not a blanket read on the market.
Confirmed XI, fitness news, and weather re-enter the prior closer to kickoff.
Bootstrap lower-bound on the Qatar side still clears the Pick threshold.

copy.summary: The model thinks Qatar are mispriced. Our number reads 34% on the away side; the market reads 24%. The +10.1pp gap is the Pick.
